item.stepcrafter.step_crafter.help: Accepts patterns for recursive autocrafting and allows setting minimum and maximum thresholds. When the output of a configured pattern falls below the minimum, it will automatically craft items up to the maximum.
item.stepcrafter.step_requester.help: Asks a nearby Step Crafter to craft a filtered item. When the item's stock in that crafter falls below the minimum, it requests batches of it up to the maximum.
